name: Gin Rummy
summary: Two players, ten cards each. Nondealer and then dealer may take the first upcard; if both pass, nondealer draws from stock. Thereafter draw or take the top discard, then discard a different card. Make sets of three or four and same-suit runs with ace low. Knock at ten deadwood or less. The app chooses a lowest-deadwood arrangement automatically. Opponent may lay off against a knock but not gin. Gin scores 25 plus opposing deadwood; an undercut scores 25 plus the difference. A normal knock scores the difference. At two stock cards the deal can end with no score. Play to 100.
